alexandra: hey folks — new hire here, trying to build runtime from source in the dev container and hitting a linker error. ubuntu 22.04, docker image nvidia/cuda:12.2. Is someone available to sanity-check?

tom: welcome! @leah is the keeper of the local dev setup docs. can you paste the exact error? :wave:

alexandra: sure — full snippet from the build: 
```
[100%] Linking CXX executable run_inference
/usr/bin/ld: CMakeFiles/run_inference.dir/src/kernels.o: in function `init_kernels':
kernels.cu:(.text+0x1234): undefined reference to `cublasLtMatmul'
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
```

leah: that one is usually a mismatch between libcublasLt visibility and the linked libs. a couple quick checks: 
- what does `ldconfig -p | grep cublasLt` show?
- is your container mounting the host driver libs? (`/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcublasLt.so` should be visible)

alexandra: `ldconfig` doesn't show cublasLt. I tried adding `-lcublas` and `-lcudart` to the link flags but same error. Dockerfile uses `FROM nvidia/cuda:12.2-devel-ubuntu22.04` and we mount /usr/local/cuda to the container.

mika: two common causes: (1) running container with a driver older than the toolkit (cublasLt was split into libcublasLt in newer toolkits), (2) the package providing libcublasLt isn't installed in the image. try `apt-get install -y libcublas-dev` inside the image or switch to the cuda image that bundles libcuBLAS fully.

alexandra: running `nvidia-smi` in the container returns driver 525.85 and it says CUDA Version: 12.1. Is that a problem with 12.2 toolkit?

leah: yes — driver 525 is borderline. CUDA 12.2 expects driver >=528. With driver 525 the loader may not expose libcublasLt. You have two options: 
1) Use `nvidia/cuda:12.1-devel` to match the host driver (quick), or
2) upgrade the host GPU driver to >=528 (admin).

alexandra: ok trying option 1 to get unstuck. switching base image now. one more dumb question — should I still install `libcublas-dev` or is the cuda image enough?

leah: for the devel image 12.1 you should be fine (it ships headers + libs). if you still see undefined refs, install `libcublas-dev` inside container and double-check `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` points to /usr/local/cuda/lib64. also run `readelf -d` on your object to confirm the needed SONAME.

buildbot: CI build 2023-11-01T14:22:31Z failed on `runtime-build` with: undefined reference to `cublasLtMatmul` — suggested fix: pin cuda image to 12.1 in Dockerfile (see pipeline #4823).

alexandra: switching to 12.1 image fixed the link, build passed. thanks all! added note to the onboarding doc about driver/toolkit mismatch. :tada:

tom: awesome — filing a small PR to templates to pin dev image until infra can upgrade drivers. thanks for the quick triage @leah @mika

leah: welcome aboard and great catch — feel free to DM for pairing on the next steps.
